verdict.rationale: The evidence covers session persistence, forking conversation history, hooks, and permission controls, but none of it describes versioning, reviewing, or rolling back automations (e.g., agent configs, workflows, or hook/tool definitions) as artifacts with change history or approval workflow. Session fork/resume (docs-21, docs-24) pertains to conversation state, not automation version control, and there is no mention of a review or rollback UI for automation definitions themselves.
